versions.changelog:
- Improved skill description for clarity and relevance to common SDLC scenarios.
- Reformatted role names for concise reference (e.g., [Dev] Developer).
- Clarified when to extract project context and how to proceed if implicit.
- Minor wording and formatting changes for better consistency and readability.
- Content and artifacts/templates remain unchanged.

SDLC Assistant 1.0.0 — initial release:

- Provides guided assistance for all common SDLC phases and roles (Developer, Tester/QA, Product Owner, Project Manager, Business Analyst).
- Automatically detects user context (role, methodology, current phase) and delivers tailored, actionable guidance.
- Includes ready-to-use templates and checklists for user stories, bug reports, test cases, Definition of Done, and more.
- Supports both Agile and Waterfall approaches with reference guides for each methodology.
- Offers practical analogies and clear next steps for each phase and role to help teams work efficiently.
